class DivZero:
    a: int

def safe_div(a: int, b: int) -> int fail DivZero:
    """Integer quotient of a divided by b. Fails with DivZero carrying a when b is 0."""
    ex safe_div(7, 2) == 3
    ex safe_div(9, 3) == 3
    ex safe_div(7, 0) == fail DivZero(a=7)
    return (fail DivZero(a=a)) if b == 0 else a // b
